stories.title: The Last Dispatch from the Ardennes
stories.description: Amidst the brutal winter of the Battle of the Bulge, a lone American radio operator sends a desperate, cryptic final message before vanishing, prompting a perilous search.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up, a gloved hand desperately cranking a field radio in a snow-covered, dimly lit foxhole, breath fogging in the freezing air, frantic intensity, 8k, Wan 2.1
scenes.visual_reference: WW2 war movie opening, tense atmosphere
scenes.negative_prompt: clear sky, sunlight, modern equipment, peaceful, easy
scenes.narration: The blizzards of '44 swallowed men whole. But some messages... they just refused to die.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot, a desolate, snow-laden forest in the Ardennes, ghostly white trees under a heavy, overcast sky, abandoned Sherman tank half-buried in snow in the foreground, bleak and cold, 8k, Wan 2.1
scenes.negative_prompt: green trees, sunny, modern vehicles, bustling city
scenes.narration: December, 1944. The Ardennes Forest was a frozen hell, trapping the Allied lines in a desperate struggle.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot, Private Thomas 'Tommy' Miller, a young, weary American radio operator with tired eyes, hunched over a SCR-300 radio in a makeshift bunker, static hissing softly, faint light from a single lantern, 8k, Wan 2.1
scenes.visual_reference: WW2 soldier portraits, period accurate equipment
scenes.negative_prompt: clean uniform, smiling, bright lights, modern technology
scenes.narration: Private Miller, isolated and freezing, was the only link for his surrounded company. His last words were always the clearest.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up, Tommy's hand gripping the microphone, knuckles white, his mouth close to the receiver, the radio's dial flickering, tension palpable as snow drifts through a gap in the bunker wall, 8k, Wan 2.1
scenes.negative_prompt: relaxed, smiling, clear connection, warm environment
scenes.narration: Then, through the static, a final, urgent whisper: 'The wolves... they're hunting. North side... the bell...' before silence.

scenes.visual_prompt: Overhead shot, a small group of American soldiers, heavily bundled against the snow, cautiously moving through a dense, snow-covered forest, rifles at the ready, looking for tracks, foreboding atmosphere, 8k, Wan 2.1
scenes.negative_prompt: clear path, open field, modern soldiers, tanks
scenes.narration: No more signals. Just the biting cold and the echoing question: what wolves? And what bell?
